class.name: HydraulicErosion
class.brief_description: High-performance particle-based hydraulic erosion for heightmap grids.
class.description: Runs a particle-based hydraulic erosion simulation on a flat heightmap grid stored as [PackedFloat32Array]. Each particle is dropped at a random position, flows downhill via bilinear gradient, and erodes or deposits sediment based on carrying capacity. Typically 50–150× faster than equivalent GDScript due to tight C++ inner loop with raw pointer access.

method.name: erode
method.description: Runs [member num_particles] erosion particles on the given heightmap. Both arrays must have length [code]resolution * resolution[/code]. Returns a Dictionary with keys "height" ([PackedFloat32Array]), "sediment" ([PackedFloat32Array]), and "completed" ([int]).

members.member: Grid resolution per axis. The heightmap has resolution × resolution cells.
Number of water particles to simulate per [method erode] call.
Blend between previous direction and gradient. 0 = pure gradient, 1 = never turns.
Carrying capacity multiplier. Higher = deeper valleys.
Fraction of excess sediment deposited per step.
Fraction of sediment deficit eroded per step.
Fraction of water evaporated per step.
Radius of the distance-weighted erosion brush in grid cells.
Maximum simulation steps per particle before it is killed.
Minimum carrying capacity to prevent zero-capacity stalls on flat terrain.
Height floor — erosion will not carve below this value.
